verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that ELSTER publishes a status page showing current server availability. That tells a founder before starting whether the online flow is reachable, but it is not a published operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session-timeout policy. Missing for 10: documented operating-hours or maintenance windows, any stated per-day submission limits, a published session-timeout duration, and independent or hands-on confirmation that these constraints are disclosed before starting the flow.
